errors.text_span: The tallest bar for mBERT corresponds to layer 12, and the shortest bar for mBERT corresponds to layer 0
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The tallest bar (most negative value, below -10) for mBERT is at layer 0. The shortest bars (values closest to 0) are for layers 7 through 11.
The value for layer 12 in the mBERT chart is approximately -1.5, not 12. The y-axis does not extend to 12.
The value for layer 0 in the mBERT chart is below -10, not approximately -8.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar for XLM-R corresponds to layer 12, and the shortest bar for XLM-R corresponds to layer 0
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The tallest bars (most negative values, around -9.5) for XLM-R are at layers 0 and 1. The shortest bars are in the higher-numbered layers (e.g., 9-12).
The value for layer 12 in the XLM-R chart is negative and very close to 0, not 11. The y-axis does not extend to 11.
The value for layer 0 in the XLM-R chart is approximately -9.5, not -6. The value at layer 3 is closer to -6.
